ticket.subject: Connecting to Slack
ticket.body_text:
Dear Support Team,

Writing on behalf of Larkspur Labs. How do we set up Slack notifications for new tasks in one project?

I saw a Slack option under Integrations, but it asks for settings I do not understand. We only want one channel, not all projects.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Thanks in advance.

Kind regards,
Yara Brandt
